description: Phase-two external comparison corpus for the Book of Mormon authorship study (H1/H2). All sources are public domain. In-repo sources are reused directly; external sources are fetched and cleaned with provenance recorded. Sidney Rigdon is documented as a GAP: no clean public-domain prose corpus was readily fetchable; he is intentionally excluded rather than approximated.

authors.note: Closest available Joseph Smith sample; shares the dictated-revelation register with the Book of Mormon (a confound to flag, but the relevant H1 comparison).

authors.license: public domain (1886 printing of the c.1812 manuscript)
